facts.fact: The terms of reference for the World Bank-funded Digital Malawi Acceleration Project describe the Data Protection Authority as a unit still to be established within MACRA, with its structure, staffing, operations manual and enforcement framework to be designed by a consultant over up to five months.

The Public Private Partnership Commission issued terms of reference (contract MW-PPPC-502049-CS-QCBS, dated October 2025, no day given) to procure a consultancy to operationalize the Data Protection Authority and draft regulations, codes of practice and guidelines under the Act.
